page.overview:
Who is Baby Tyrannosaurus Rex?

The Baby Tyrannosaurus rex, also known as Baby T-Rex, Baby Tyrannosaur, Baby T. rex, Tyrannosaurus Rex (Baby), Young T. rex, or Juvenile T. rex, is a small dinosaur. A DUPLO Dino figure was first introduced in 1997, while a System variant first appeared in 2000 with the line.

The 1997 DUPLO Dino Baby T-Rex figure is a single static piece, acting as a compliment to the regular original Tyrannosaurus rex figure which also appeared the same year in the same LEGO set line. It is most commonly available in bright red with yellow spots, but also appears in bright bluish violet with yellow spots.

A new piece, Part 30464, was introduced in 2000 to represent a Baby T-Rex in System sets. This continued to be used through 2009 in various colors. Unlike the DUPLO figure, this piece only has molded details and no printing, although its appearances in video games give it additional colors and details.

A non-physical variant of Baby T. rex appears in LEGO Jurassic World, inspired by the new T. rex molds in the and Jurassic World themes.
